reels.title: esp32-iphone-agent: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP3

editorial_notes.reasoning: This topic taps into the high-velocity 'robotics/hardware_efficiency' category. The 'AI-in-the-loop-with-physical-hardware' concept is visually arresting and perfect for 3b1b-style kinetic animations, showing how low-cost microcontrollers can become the 'nervous system' for a smartphone.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could give an AI eyes and fingers to control a real iPhone using only a $7 chip?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Treating the ESP32 microcontroller like a tiny, dedicated 'nervous system' that converts AI digital thoughts into physical finger taps on a screen.
